title: rangetest: RANGETEST_TRACE_CBOR_MAX 640 below worst-case 657 for 8 full-form hops
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_rangetest.c:29: 640 bytes but module's own LICHEN_RANGETEST_MAX_HOPS=8 with 39-char full-notation IPv6 needs 41 envelope + 8x77 = 657 (45-char worst case 705). Legal traceroutes fail closed 5.03 via -ENOBUFS at :826-831. Fix: raise to >=720 (41+8x83); add a host/twister test exercising max-hop traceroute encode.
close_reason: coap_rangetest.c: RANGETEST_TRACE_CBOR_MAX 640 -> 720 with derivation comment (worst case 41 fixed + 8x83 per max-length hop = 705 bytes; 8 hops x [map(1)+"addr"(5)+0x78-hdr 45-char addr(47)+"rssi"(5)+f64(9)+"rtt_ms"(7)+f64(9)]). New ztest test_traceroute_max_hops_encode asserts canonical 8-hop/45-char-addr encode == 705 exactly and -ENOBUFS at 704 (old 640 could not hold it). Twister qemu_x86/atom: 1/1 configs, 7/7 test cases passed (6 original vector cases still byte-exact). Commits: <code> + beads state.
